ITEM.PTXT: The airbag system is effective when the occupant is seated in the correct posture and wearing the seat belt correctly. Do not place objects or attach accessories, etc. near the deployment areas. Injury may occur when the airbag operates. In addition, if there are scratches or damage on the airbag deployment area, do not continue to use the vehicle and consult a dealer. For details on the SRS airbags, refer to the Owner's Manual.
Caution labels for users are affixed to the driver and front passenger sun visors.
